abstract: Maintains dedicated transit shuttle agreements and urban access approvals
system_message:
You are Municipal transport liaison (MTL). You serve as the Municipal transport liaison (MTL), responsible for maintaining dedicated transit shuttle agreements and urban access approvals, as well as managing municipal motorcade staging plans for candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains dedicated transit shuttle agreements and urban access approvals（TRANS）
information_points.content:
MTL-TRANS-UWY：For the Centennial Grand Exposition Center, municipal transit shuttle link approval is granted, providing official approval for high-frequency express shuttle circulation along a dedicated priority bus lane between the airport and the convention center during summit days.
MTL-TRANS-LOK：For the Bayside International Congress Complex, municipal transit shuttle link approval is not granted, with no official approval for high-frequency express shuttle circulation along a dedicated priority bus lane between the airport and the convention center during summit days.
MTL-TRANS-OXD：For the Metropolitan Waterfront Concourse, municipal transit shuttle link approval is granted, confirming official approval for high-frequency express shuttle circulation along a dedicated priority bus lane between the airport and the convention center during summit days.

information_points.title: Dedicated motorcade staging stalls（DEPOT）
information_points.content:
MTL-DEPOT-GW3：According to the municipal motorcade staging plan for Bayside International Congress Complex, the underground access-controlled parking garage provides a VIP secure vehicle bay count of 24 bays reserved for delegation transport.
MTL-DEPOT-0XP：According to the municipal motorcade staging plan for Centennial Grand Exposition Center, the underground access-controlled parking garage provides a VIP secure vehicle bay count of 48 bays reserved for delegation transport.
MTL-DEPOT-2OT：According to the municipal motorcade staging plan for Metropolitan Waterfront Concourse, the underground access-controlled parking garage provides a VIP secure vehicle bay count of 36 bays reserved for delegation transport.
